name: Nagareyama Shimon
source:
One of the Hachiyou, he is the Suzaku of Earth. Shimon is a junior high student and a friend of Akane who also is pulled into Kyou. The Oni Clan is said to have blond hair and blue eyes, and because Shimon has a similar appearance, the people of Kyou often mistake him for an Oni. His elemental attribute is Earth, and his dragon jewel is located on the back of his right hand.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de]Wikipedia[/url]]
